title: bug: importee-guard-bash.test.mjs "Bash stream parser refuses a tool path holding a control character" (added by 96c4ee19, task-414eae5a) compares the parser's witness file and stdout as LF-only, but Windows Python writes text-mode CRLF, so the case fails under Windows node and CI's Windows "Test Bash landing and postflight runner" step has been red since 11-02
description:
Filed by hunt #22 (task-7a3640da), from a dry run of CI's windows-latest leg at fec9a842 on the Windows host.

PROBLEM
- The case at scripts/tests/importee-guard-bash.test.mjs:298-326 runs STREAM_JSON_PARSER with `python`, which is the win32 choice at :12. It makes two assertions:
  - :321 `readFileSync(tools, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean)` deep-equals ['plain.txt'];
  - :323 `run.stdout.includes(\`  [WARN] tool write outside the repo not harvested: ${raw}\n\`)`, once for each refused raw path.
- The parser writes the witness file in text mode (`open(harvest_path, 'a', encoding='utf-8')`, moe-agent.sh:11925) and writes stdout in text mode too. On Windows, Python then turns every '\n' into '\r\n', including the '\n' inside the refused raw paths.
- Production is not affected. resolve_attribution reads the file with `line.rstrip('\n').rstrip('\r')` (moe-agent.sh:4516), and the WARN lines are display only. This is a test-only defect.
- 96c4ee19's verification ran the file under Linux node only. ubuntu-latest passes; windows-latest's "Test Bash landing and postflight runner" step (ci.yml:289-290) fails.

EVIDENCE (Windows node 24.16.0 and Python 3.14, outside the shared checkout)
- CI emulation of the windows-latest leg at fec9a842: a Windows-git clone at D:\moe-scratch\h22\w with a runner-like environment. The step exited 1 with tests 64, pass 63, fail 1. Log: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/logs/w-15-Test-Bash-landing-and-postflight-runner.log
- First error lines:
  ✖ Bash stream parser refuses a tool path holding a control character, forging no second witness line
    AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
    + actual - expected
      [
    +   'plain.txt\r'
    -   'plain.txt'
      ]
        at TestContext.<anonymous> (file:///D:/moe-scratch/h22/w/scripts/tests/importee-guard-bash.test.mjs:321:12)
- Bisect, single file under Windows node on a git-archive of scripts and docs:
  - 617c5658 (96c4ee19^): 40/40 pass;
  - 96c4ee19: 41 tests, 1 fail (this case).
  TAPs: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/bisect2/{pre,at}.tap
- Fixing only :321 exposes :323. The real stdout holds `...harvested: ok.txt\r\nforged.txt\r\n`, which does not include `ok.txt\nforged.txt\n`.
- Fix check: with `.split(/\r?\n/)` at :321 and `run.stdout.replaceAll('\r\n', '\n').includes(...)` at :323, the file passes 41/41 under Windows node and 41/41 under Linux node (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/fixcheck/).

FIX DIRECTION
- Test-only: turn CRLF into LF before both assertions. Replacing only '\r\n' pairs keeps the lone '\r' in the Write case's raw path, so that check still bites. A one-line comment should say why: Windows Python writes text-mode CRLF.
- Do not change STREAM_JSON_PARSER or moe-agent.sh; their reader already accepts CRLF.
- Leave the ps1 twin alone. scripts/tests/importee-guard.ps1, also from 96c4ee19, passed on PowerShell 5.1 and 7 (53/53) in the same run.

FILES: scripts/tests/importee-guard-bash.test.mjs only.
definitionOfDone: Run from a git-archive snapshot of scripts and docs outside the shared checkout, `"/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test scripts/tests/importee-guard-bash.test.mjs` reports at least 41 tests with fail 0.
Under Linux node the same file reports fail 0.

`git diff --stat` for the task names only scripts/tests/importee-guard-bash.test.mjs. The case still asserts that the witness file holds exactly ['plain.txt'] and that each of the 3 refused raw paths has its WARN line.
